detail.title: AI Security Screening System
detail.overview: Favourite ISC-M6040D AI Security Screening System Key Points ●620mm×420mm ●Dual-Energy Dual-View Security Screening Machine ●Wire Resolution：Horizontal View ：Typical 40AWG;Standard 38AWG， Vertical View：Typical 40AWG; Standard 40AWG ● Penetration(Steel)：Horizontal View ：Typical 40 mm; Standard: 34 mm， Vertical View：Typical 41 mm; Standard 40 mm ●Ai Algorithm In Recognizes 33types Of Objects ●2 Built-In Cameras, Monitoring Tunnel Entry & Exit ●Speed Adjustment-Supports Three-Speed Adjustment (0.2, 0.3, 0.4 m/s). ●Intelligent Energy-Saving Function. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.X-ray Tube Cooling: Sealed oil bath with forced air
General.Wire Resolution: horizontal view: Typical 40AWG(0.079mm); standard 38AWG(0.102mm) Vertical view: Typical 40AWG(0.079mm); standard 40AWG(0.079mm)
General.Penetration (steel): horizontal view: Typical 40 mm; standard: 34 mm Vertical view: Typical 41 mm; standard 40 mm

Function.Live View: AI recognizes the scanned objects. And the AI box tracks the real-time movement of the objects. It support custom modification of the color of text and boxes.
Function.Type Recognition: Supports intelligent recognition of over a hundred categories of prohibited and restricted items, including knives, guns, law enforcement equipment, aerosol cans, liquids, batteries, fireworks, tools, walkie-talkies, drones, etc.
Function.Danger Level: Algorithm sensitivity settings for three levels (high, medium, low) are supported, allowing for the configuration of different security screening strategies based on types such as land transport, air transport, and special regulations.
Function.Event Linkage: The sound and light alarm (Alarm IO output), audio prompt, platform alarm, screen prompt and more will be triggered according to danger level.
Function.Image Storage: Supports storage for more than 1 million pictures. The picture includes danger level and item type, the original picture and the AI picture can be selected to view.
Function.Baggage Search: Supports search according to time, object type and more, playback and export scanned baggage images and associated videos.
Function.TIP Management: Supports the random insertion of dangerous good images into scanned package images generated during normal operations. Parameters include the insertion frequency and proportion of various types of dangerous goods, along with start and end times for the insertion can be configured. Additionally, relevant item insertion reports and assessment reports can be queried.
Function.Package Linkage: Configurable front entrance camera support the capture of packages, which are then linked with X-ray imaging and stored for easy retrieval by security screener and travelers for review.
Function.Image Processing: Supports the following image enhancement effects: color/ black & white, partial enhancement, super enhancement, edge enhancement, scanning, organic material stripping, inorganic material stripping, mixture stripping, inverse color, high energy enhancement, low energy enhancement, light, dark, density threat alert Z7/Z8/Z9, high density alert, AI overlay, vertical flip, pseudo color, etc.
Function.Intelligent Temperature Control: Detects the temperature of main board and HDD and automatically adjusts fan speed to make it work stably and quietly.
